rustApi.inputBorrowing: All three arguments are shared immutable borrows for the duration of the call only.
rustApi.outputOwnership: CoreCompletion owns every transitive byte of findings, Coverage, policy outcome, diagnostics, budget usage, deficiency, and normalized fault cause. It contains no borrow, raw pointer, handle, guard, iterator, closure, trait object, Arc/Rc cell, or lifetime parameter tied to an input.
rustApi.noLifetimeFork: There is exactly one API. No by-value, mutable-borrow, callback, async, streaming, resident, or lifetime-parameterized alternate evaluate entry point is permitted.

schemaLanguage.record: fieldOrder is exhaustive and required; optionalFields is always []; unknown fields reject; JSON object key order is not semantic, but canonical encoding emits fieldOrder.
schemaLanguage.array: items are validated recursively; orderRule and uniquenessRule are binding and never inferred from producer assertions.
schemaLanguage.integer: u64 and u128 are exact JSON integers; booleans, floats, negative values, and values above the declared maximum reject.
schemaLanguage.string: UTF-8 JSON string satisfying the declared non-empty/pattern rule; no normalization is silently performed.
schemaLanguage.union: variant is the closed discriminator and selects one exhaustive closed record.
schemaLanguage.null: null is invalid unless a field specification explicitly permits it; no v1.5 core value does.

planStageIds.orderRule: caller-declared Plan stage order; preserve byte-for-byte

AttemptMetadata.ownership: allocated by the one-shot host at durable attempt admission and injected; never minted, modified, or persisted by the core
AttemptMetadata.identity: excluded from EvidenceDigest and every content-derived evidence identity

entries.orderRule: strict ascending UTF-8 byte order by ruleId

FindingList.orderRule: strict ascending tuple of UTF-8 bytes (ruleId, findingId, valueDigest)

entries.orderRule: strict ascending UTF-8 byte order by coverageKey

records.orderRule: strict emission order; ordinal starts at zero and increments by one for every attempted emission, including dropped emissions

localEvaluationState.escapeRule: All state is allocated inside evaluate, is unreachable before return, and is destroyed before return except for deep-owned DiagnosticsData and BudgetUsage copied into CoreCompletion. No reference or handle to local state escapes.

counters.initialization: remaining.ruleUnits = deps.budgetLimits.ruleUnits; remaining.policyUnits = deps.budgetLimits.policyUnits; used values start at zero.
counters.unitCharge: Before exactly one rule or policy evaluation unit, test the corresponding remaining counter. If zero, perform no unit, decrement nothing, and take the exhaustion transition. Otherwise subtract exactly one using checked u64 subtraction and add exactly one to the corresponding used counter using checked u64 addition.
counters.exhaustion: The first failed charge ends evaluation deterministically. The coverageKey named by that charge is set to budget-exhausted; CoreCompletion is incomplete with deficiency budget-exhausted and an indeterminate policyOutcome. No later scripted unit or diagnostic is evaluated.
counters.overflow: Budget limit values above u64, negative integers, booleans, and floats reject before evaluate. Since used never exceeds its same-kind initial u64 limit, checked increment cannot overflow; any implementation-observed arithmetic failure is a contract fault and must not wrap, saturate, or continue.
counters.directSemanticEffect: Budget accounting directly changes only ExactCoverage by the declared first-failed-charge rule. The incomplete variant, deficiency, and indeterminate policy outcome are consequences derived from that Coverage; budget limits or usage never enter findings or evidence identity directly.

diagnosticsBuffer.initialization: empty records, nextOrdinal = 0u128, droppedCount = 0u128, capacity = deps.budgetLimits.diagnosticRecords
diagnosticsBuffer.emission: For each deterministic diagnostic candidate, assign current nextOrdinal then checked-increment nextOrdinal. If records.len < capacity, deep-copy the record into records and increment diagnosticRecordsAccepted; otherwise retain no record and checked-increment droppedCount and diagnosticRecordsDropped.
diagnosticsBuffer.ordering: Records preserve emission order exactly. No sorting, deduplication, replacement, sampling, or severity preference is permitted.
diagnosticsBuffer.truncation: The first capacity records are retained and every later record is dropped. capacity zero is the valid no-op diagnostics form.
diagnosticsBuffer.droppedCount: Exact count of all attempted emissions not retained. u128 is used because the sum of two independently bounded u64 evaluation domains can exceed u64.
diagnosticsBuffer.semanticNeutrality: Changing diagnostic capacity, diagnostic messages, retained records, dropped count, or AttemptMetadata cannot change the evidence projection, findings, Coverage, or policy outcome.

evidenceIdentity.actualOwner: the host/evidence layer; this contract does not redefine the product EvidenceDigest grammar
evidenceIdentity.conformanceCommitmentGrammar: SHA-256 over UTF-8 bytes of prefix opensip:r1-v1.5:projection\u0000 followed by strict JSON of the declared variant projection: keys in the listed order, arrays in contract order, no whitespace, ensure_ascii=false, no floats. This is a conformance equality oracle only, not a replacement EvidenceDigest grammar.
evidenceIdentity.requiredEquality: Identical semantic inputs and semantic completion with different ExecutionId and/or diagnostics capacity produce byte-identical conformance projection commitments, demonstrating that those fields cannot alter EvidenceDigest through this API.

d9Boundary.coreMayReturn: only one validated inert D9NormalizedFaultCause value in the faulted variant
d9Boundary.derivationOwner: opensip-d9 in the host finalization boundary

staticInstruments.scope: all six Cargo dependency classes plus workspace inheritance, renames, features, build scripts, tests, examples, and benches
recursive import and call closure from every opensip-core target through the declared direct graph
compiled artifact symbols, linked native objects, FFI declarations, dynamic-load strings, build-script products, proc-macro expansion products

forbiddenReach: host callback, diagnostics callback, effect port, service locator, trait-object collaborator
RefCell, UnsafeCell, Cell, Mutex, RwLock, Atomic*, thread_local, static mut, global mutable singleton
staticAndRuntimeClosure.boundedClaim: Passing all three static instruments establishes only bounded static/import/binary closure for the inspected bytes and dependency graph.

runtimeDenial.blockedOn: a named restricted runtime and ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT
runtimeDenial.forbiddenInference: Absence from the signature, schema, source graph, or linked binary is not proof that a runtime denies ambient capability attempts.

staticAndRuntimeClosure.untrustedImperativeRules: EXCLUDED until a restricted runtime and negative escape suite exist

conformanceModel.executionOrder: Process events in array order. Exactly one terminal return is last unless the first failed charge terminates earlier. A diagnostic event is allowed only immediately after a successful charge and at most one diagnostic follows each successful charge.
conformanceModel.vectorOracle: Initialize local state from CoreDeps; interpret events by localEvaluationState; merge derived DiagnosticsData and BudgetUsage into completionTemplate; validate the resulting CoreCompletion recursively; compare it exactly with expectedCompletion; recompute the conformance projection commitment.
conformanceModel.exhaustionTemplateRule: A vector that can exhaust carries exhaustionCompletion. At first failed charge the checker uses that semantic template, rewrites exactly the matching coverageKey state to budget-exhausted, and derives diagnostics/budget usage from the executed prefix.

adversarialControls.mutation: set u64 max after one charge

requiredCheckerProperties.sourceIntegrity: Every frozen input and external vocabulary source is read as bytes and checked against its exact SHA-256 before use. No repository Python checker is imported; if a successor ever imports one it must compile and execute the authenticated source buffer in an isolated namespace and ignore .pyc.
normalMode: recursive total validation of every declared closed type
exact Phase 3 Rust mapping and package dependency reconstruction
source vocabulary recomputation rather than producer assertion
positive-vector budget, diagnostic, completion, ownership, and identity recomputation
hostile top-level and nested shapes return findings rather than exceptions
selftest: refuse when the unmutated base has any finding or any source hash drift
every named mutation changes the intended bytes/value exactly once
failure-to-apply, no-op, duplicate mutation id, skipped mutation, or a mutation without a finding is an escape
strict raw duplicate/nonfinite/float probes run independently of object mutation
the live contract bytes remain unchanged from selftest start to end
